parameters.name: CredentialConfig
parameters.description: 链式授权配置。**如无特殊需求，请保持留空即可**

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
高光识别模式。

- Scene：场景和帧识别

- Average（默认）：平均切片识别

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: 消息通知配置，详细内容请单击 Notification 查看，异步通知消息格式请参见[异步通知消息格式](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/imm/developer-reference/asynchronous-notification-message-examples)

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description:
需要处理的媒体资源列表。
上限 10 个视频。

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: 自定义标签，用于对异步任务进行搜索、过滤。

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
处理类型。

- Retrieval：高光提取

- Concat：视频合成

- Compose：一键成片

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: 用户自定义信息，在异步消息通知中会返回。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun imm create-highlight-task --project-name immtest --sources StartTime=0.0 Duration=0.0 URI=oss://test-bucket/test-object --biz-mode Average --type Retrieval --highlight Content=character --edit '{"Transitions":[{"Transition":"fade","Duration":0.0,"Weight":50}],"Mode":"Sequential","BackgroundMusicMode":"Closed","VfxEffects":[{"VfxEffect":"letterboxed","Weight":50}],"TransitionMode":"Closed","BackgroundMusics":[{"Volume":0.2,"URI":"oss://test-bucket/test-object/test.mp3"}],"VfxEffectMode":"Closed"}' --biz-output '{"Speed":1.0,"Container":"mp4","Video":"example-string","MaxDuration":10.0,"Audio":"example-string","URI":"oss://test-bucket/test-target-object.mp4","Segment":{"Format":"hls","Duration":1.0,"StartNumber":0}}' --user-data ID_:_testuid_,_Name_:_test-user_,_Avatar_:_http://test.com/testuid --tags test=val1 --credential-config example-string --notification example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun imm CreateHighlightTask --region cn-hangzhou --Type Retrieval --Highlight '{"Content":"character"}' --ProjectName immtest --UserData 'ID_:_testuid_,_Name_:_test-user_,_Avatar_:_http://test.com/testuid' --CredentialConfig 'example-string' --Mode Average --Output '{"Speed":1.0,"Container":"mp4","Video":"example-string","MaxDuration":10.0,"Audio":"example-string","URI":"oss://test-bucket/test-target-object.mp4","Segment":{"Format":"hls","Duration":1.0,"StartNumber":0}}' --Edit '{"Transitions":[{"Transition":"fade","Duration":0.0,"Weight":50}],"Mode":"Sequential","BackgroundMusicMode":"Closed","VfxEffects":[{"VfxEffect":"letterboxed","Weight":50}],"TransitionMode":"Closed","BackgroundMusics":[{"Volume":0.2,"URI":"oss://test-bucket/test-object/test.mp3"}],"VfxEffectMode":"Closed"}' --Sources '[{"StartTime":0.0,"Duration":0.0,"URI":"oss://test-bucket/test-object"}]' --Tags '{"test":"val1"}' --Notification 'example-string'
